changeSet.author: aqua-rush
changeSet.comment: Align payment_refunds.status CHECK with RefundStatus enum (R-PAY-02)
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE payment_refunds DROP CONSTRAINT chk_payment_refunds_status;
ALTER TABLE payment_refunds ADD CONSTRAINT chk_payment_refunds_status CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED'));
